vacuum_box.name: The Floating Box
vacuum_box.description: A box floats motionless inside a vacuum chamber, with nothing touching it.

questions.prompt: A box floats motionless in a vacuum. What net force acts on it?
If the box is motionless, what does that tell you about the forces acting on it?

sinking_stone.name: The Sinking Stone
sinking_stone.description: A stone released underwater sinks at a constant speed and never gets any faster.

questions.prompt: A stone sinks through water at a constant speed, never speeding up. What does that tell you about the net force on it?
If the net force is zero, what must be true about gravity pulling it down versus drag pushing up?

hot_cold_chairs.name: Two Chairs, Same Temperature
hot_cold_chairs.description: A metal chair and a wooden chair sit in the same room, but the metal one feels colder to the touch.

questions.prompt: The metal chair feels colder than the wooden one, even though both are the same temperature. What property of the material is actually different?
If both chairs are the same temperature, what is really different about how fast heat leaves your hand when you touch each one?
